name: Palazzo Ripetta
description: Palazzo Ripetta is a 5-star hotel affiliated with Relais & Châteaux, located between Piazza del Popolo and Piazza di Spagna, in the central Via di Ripetta. Housed in a historic building dating back to the 16th century and renovated in the 1960s according to an elegant design by architect Luigi Walter Moretti, one of the most eminent figures of 20th century Italian architecture, the hotel is the perfect combination of history, art and architecture. Authentic 1960s interiors harmoniously marry the interior design of the renovation that enhances Architect Moretti's historic design by adding comfort and studied contemporary luxury. 78 rooms, 4 meeting & event rooms with natural light, the restaurant, the cocktail bar and an exclusive rooftop now welcome guests in discreet and elegant luxury, totally sustainable and carefully designed for their well-being.
